(2) Page not in trim, no fix: Nonmajor (55,930,959) vs nonmajor schedules 6,466,946 + 313,504 = 6,780,450; the other 49,150,509 is nonmajor funds without a schedule in the trim. 39,265,108 + 49,150,509 = 88,415,617. All existing transfer lines carry the right label for their sign.

The only nonmajor schedule printing debt is Riverfront Redevelopment Special Tax Fund p32: Issuance of debt 4,435,000 and Premium on debt issued 605,064, both in detail. Adding the Nonmajor cell would double count 4,435,000; 147,730,000 - 4,435,000 = 143,295,000 would be a derived figure for nonmajor funds whose schedules are not in the trim. Same for the p6 Nonmajor Premium on debt issued 12,082,268 (605,064 in detail, remainder 11,477,204 derived). Other financing rows already in detail: Debt Service premium 432,424 (p31 = p6), GOCVB Issuance of long-term lease 494,174 (p27 = p6 Nonmajor), Nonmajor Proceeds on sale of capital assets 4,969,923 (p6, pass 2).
